3139-4659-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-4659-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-4659-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Great Henge, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

618-1916-4050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2023-2079-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4488-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-4488-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2921-3861-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

751-5943-7426.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
751-5943-7426.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
751-5943-7426.notes: You can repeat this combo until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.

3375-4399-4506-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4506-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

465-670-1619-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6136.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Avenging Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-3480-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3480-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2438-6112-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-6112-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Fumulus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3459-4289-5078-5243.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3755-5864-7110-7111.notablePrerequisites: You control four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats that do not have summoning sickness.
3755-5864-7110-7111.description:
Activate at least four Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Get Out by paying {U}{U}, targeting Stormchaser's Talent. Stormchaser's Talent's first ability, Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve the Stormchaser Talent trigger, creating a 1/1 Otter creature token with prowess.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Get Out, returning Stormchaser's Talent from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate at least four Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Stormchaser's Talent by paying {U}. Valley Floodcaller and each creature you control that has prowess trigger.
Resolve each prowess trigger, if applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Valley Floodcaller trigger, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Stormchaser's Talent by paying {3}{U}, causing it to gain level 2. It then triggers, returning Get Out from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6289-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

147-5686-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5686-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3488-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3488-4222-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3488-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

4875-5296-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}
Repeat.
4875-5296-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Workhorse for additional mana.

386-790-5076.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
386-790-5076.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

877-3001-4050.description:
Cast Mortus Strider by paying {1} due to Morophon.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mortus Strider, adding {1}.
When Mortus Strider dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

116-2569-4890.notablePrerequisites:
Dack's Duplicate is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Dack's Duplicate do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-4890.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Dack's Duplicate.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by tapping it.
When Dack's Duplicate becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Dack's Duplicate's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2511-2730-4871-5006.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
2511-2730-4871-5006.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

802-1309-1671-3400-3664.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Ivy triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ivy from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field by tapping them, adding {G}{U} and three mana of any color.
Resolve Snap, returning Salvager of Secrets from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Simic Growth Chamber and Lotus Field.
Cast Ivy by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Salvager of Secrets by paying {3}{U}{U}.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1109-1636-2263-2292.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Mindcrusher does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1109-1636-2263-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, causing target player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Repeat.

862-2034-2173-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

376-678-944-4050.description:
Cast Cubwarden for its mutate cost by paying {W}{W}, targeting a non-Human creature you control.
The Cubwarden mutated creature triggers, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cubwarden mutated creature, adding {W}.
When the Cubwarden mutated creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cubwarden and any cards merged with it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

193-1124-1180.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' abilities this turn.
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to draw a card and then put a card on top of your library from your hand.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Nicol Bolas.
Activate Nicol Bolas' first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to draw a card and each opponent to exile either a card from their hand or a permanent they control.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
